title: Hidden Gems of Lake Como
subtitle: 6 Hours Private Tour Proposal
intro_title: An elegant day on the water
intro: A 6-hour private experience that pairs effortless cruising on Lake Como with a relaxing stop for lunch at the Grand Hotel Tremezzo. You will glide past the lake's most iconic villas — from Villa d'Este to George Clooney's and the Hollywood villas of Gucci, Star Wars and Casino Royale — before discovering hidden waterfalls and timeless lakeside towns. Departure from Como with a chilled Prosecco aperitivo on board.
itinerary: Villa Erba · Villa d'Este · Villa Versace
Villa del Balbianello — Star Wars & Casino Royale
Isola Comacina — the only island of the lake
Tremezzo · lunch at Grand Hotel Tremezzo
Bellagio — the pearl of the lake

highlights.name: Villa Pliniana
highlights.desc: A historic 16th-century villa on Lake Como, in Torno. A scenic waterfall runs through the property, creating a dramatic natural feature behind the villa.

highlights.name: Villa La Cassinella
highlights.desc: A luxurious private villa on the shores of Lake Como, known for its stunning views and exclusive, secluded setting. Accessible only by boat, it is one of the most prestigious and private residences in the region.

highlights.name: Villa del Balbianello
highlights.desc: Disembark at the exclusive FAI dock for a self-guided walk through the lush terraced gardens of one of the most photographed landmarks on the lake, featured in Star Wars and James Bond films.

highlights.name: Bellagio
highlights.desc: Step ashore for a gelato stop in the charming cobbled streets of Bellagio, often referred to as the pearl of Lake Como.

highlights.name: Orrido di Nesso
highlights.desc: A breathtaking natural gorge where a powerful waterfall flows through the village of Nesso, passing under a picturesque medieval stone bridge — one of the most photogenic hidden gems of the lake, best admired from the water.

highlights.name: Varenna
highlights.desc: Disembark and wander the romantic lanes of Varenna, enjoying a gelato in one of the most enchanting villages on the eastern shore.

boat.name: Gozzo Sorrentino
boat.desc: A traditional Italian wooden boat, common along the Mediterranean coasts. Stable and elegant in its simplicity, it is the authentic way to enjoy the lake — calm, intimate and timeless.
